product: Opakalim (BHV-7000), an oral selective Kv7.2/7.3 activator for refractory focal epilepsy, studied in over 1,200 participants (2026-08-26 8-K). Broader pipeline: BHV-1300 for Graves disease, BHV-1400 for IgA nephropathy, taldefgrobep alfa for obesity, and oncology ADCs BHV-1530/BHV-1510 (2026-08-10 PR).
demand: Not a commercial-stage company, so no price/volume/mix split. Revenue is collaboration and licensing driven: stockanalysis lists FY2026 revenue about $50M. Near-term growth is the SK Biopharma cash ($350M at closing, $50M in 2027) plus milestones and royalties (mid-teens to low-twenties US royalty), not unit economics.
pricing_power: No product margins exist yet; the analogue is cash burn. Q2 2026 R&D was $100.8M and net loss $137.3M against $270.5M cash (2026-08-10). A full clinical hold or failure of the SK deal to close would force dilutive financing and shrink effective runway, the real margin-collapse risk.
competition: not found. No dated evidence of a Chinese low-cost opakalim/Kv7 substitute was located. The market instead has generic older antiseizure drugs and branded cenobamate (XCOPRI, owned by the new partner SK Biopharmaceuticals). No sourced URL or date for a China-based Kv7 competitor.
market_strategy: CEO Vlad Coric, 2026-08-26: the SK deal brings $400 million in near-term, non-dilutive capital while preserving substantial long-term upside. On 2026-08-10 he said opakalim's pivotal readout is later this year and RISE3 topline remains on track for 2H 2026, with BHV-1400 pivotal in IgAN 2H 2026.
bull: RISE 3 pivotal enrollment completed 2026-06-30 and BHV7000-303 topline remains on track for 2H 2026 per the 2026-09-10 8-K; the SK Biopharma deal (2026-08-26) adds $350M at closing plus $50M in 2027, non-dilutive.
bear: FDA partial clinical hold dated 2026-09-04 pauses new BHV-7000 enrollment; shares fell 10-17% on 2026-09-10. Cash $270.5M against $259.5M notes; SK deal unclosed pending HSR, so targets may assume cash not banked.
falsifier: An FDA escalation of the 2026-09-04 partial hold to a full clinical hold on BHV-7000, or RISE3/BHV7000-303 topline slipping past 2026-12-31.

Third-order: the epilepsy clinical and commercial ecosystem.

In IgA nephropathy: Vera, Novartis, Otsuka. In Graves disease: Immunovant and other anti-FcRn/APRIL players.
